title: Monolith Ownership Extraction Schema
description: End-to-end ownership extraction for the monolith prompt. One parent array of self-contained records (entity identity + embedded ownership links + per-record audit), so the output batches cleanly via submitBatch(json, "extracted_records"). The client entity is the record with layer 0. Chart is reconstructed by walking owners[] links across records using layer for hierarchy.

extracted_records.description: One record per distinct entity/person across all documents. Self-contained: each record carries its own ownership links, conflicts, cycle membership, gaps, and flags. Do NOT duplicate an entity across records even if it appears in multiple documents or paths; record multiple owners as multiple owners[] entries.

id.description: Slug: lowercase name, spaces to underscores. Stable; referenced by owners[].owner_id of other records.

name.description: Legal name exactly as stated in the document.

entity_classification.description: Structural tag per system rule 4.3 ENTITY CLASSIFICATION (captures GP/LP/Fund Vehicle roles the legal type alone does not convey).

entity_type_category.description: KYC category for this entity. For the layer-0 client record this is the client classification decided first (system rules 5 + 6).

layer.description: Ownership layer relative to the client. 0 = client, 1 = direct owners of client, 2 = their owners, etc. (system rule 4.1).

document_name.description: Name of the source document this entity record was extracted from.

document_path.description: GCS path / file path of the source document this entity record was extracted from.

isUBO.description: True if this entity/person is a UBO of the client.

isIBO.description: True if this entity/person is an IBO of the client.

proof_source.description: Source document name + section/page evidencing the listing.

listing_proof.description: Populate for Listed entities only (Category 2 / system rule 6 step 1). null otherwise.

classification_reasoning.description: Entity type reasoning + the document page/section that evidences this entity.

owners.description: Direct owners (parents) of this entity. One entry per ownership link into this entity. Empty array if this entity has no identified owner (top parent, natural-person UBO, orphan SPV, or the client where not owned). Multiple entries capture multi-path / convergence (system rule 4.3); never collapse paths.

owner_id.description: id (slug) of the owner's own record in extracted_records, when that owner is itself an emitted record; null otherwise.

owner_name.description: Legal name of the owning entity/person exactly as stated.

ownership_percentage_direct.description: Direct % this owner holds in this entity, exactly as stated (e.g. '55%', '12.5%'). 'Not Available' if absent, 'Negligible' for <=0.01%. Never assume (system rules 4.3 Percentage / 9).

gp_lp_role.description: GP/LP role of this owner in this relationship where applicable (system rule 4.2).

control.description: Control / domination indicator for this link, ONLY when supported by evidence (system rule 9). Empty string if no evidenced control.

source.description: Document name + page/section evidencing this relationship.

source_type.description: Provenance within the document: read from a visual org chart, or from non-chart text (registers, tables, prose).

direction_proof.description: Text/visual evidence proving the owner->owned direction (page/section text or chart annotation stating who owns whom).

conflicts.description: Conflicting % values for THIS ownership link across documents. Capture ALL conflicting values with sources; do NOT resolve (system rule 4.3 Data Conflict / 8). Empty array if no conflict.

source.description: Document name + page/section for this conflicting value.

cycle_path.description: Ordered node ids of the circular-ownership cycle this entity participates in (entity reachable from itself via ownership links), detected by DFS over owners[] links. Empty array if this entity is not part of a cycle.

data_gaps.description: Missing/incomplete data for this entity (missing %, incomplete layer, missing document), with document reference. Empty string if none.

exceptions.description: Exceptions / special handling for this entity (e.g. orphan SPV no ownership identified, 'Share Trustee identified - add as IBO'). Empty string if none.

qaFlags.description: Quality-assurance and inference flags for this record (mirrors the CSM qaFlags capture, per record). Empty array if none.

reason.description: A clear explanation of the QA / inference flag.

outOfBounds.description: Out-of-bounds assessment for this record (mirrors the CSM outOfBounds capture, per record). isOutOfBounds=false with reason/status omitted when in scope.

isOutOfBounds.description: True if this entity/person/record falls outside the defined scope of ownership extraction.

reason.description: Why this record is out of bounds. Omit when isOutOfBounds is false.

status.description: OOB status category. Omit when isOutOfBounds is false.
